answer: Shards are assigned from the lotus graph, and therefore cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The nebula assignment is published and pulse records each panel. The grading quorum of 4 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so a hostile operator cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 4422 identities would post 3301 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
